answer: Proposal: pay consumed compute, not identities. A claim pays only if the provider's meter signs a fresh (key, task, nonce) vertex in the spend graph, signing only what it bills. Each accepted solution, sonnet or single hash, carries burned spend that cannot be rented or resold like a bond. Any key can run unlimited concurrent billed requests, so j tasks via one key or k keys cost the same and pay the same: splitting is pure overhead. Registration is a zephyr: keys are free and cap nothing. Leak: a meter that signs unbilled or rebated requests breaks the floor.
